title: Continuous-time directed polymers to the Critical SHF via moments
summary: We consider a class of two-dimensional continuous-time directed random polymers in a correlated Brownian environment. The partition functions of these polymers form a discrete approximation of the Critical Stochastic Heat Flow (SHF), constructed by Caravenna, Sun and Zygouras (2023). Using a recent moment based axiomatic characterization of the SHF by Tsai (2024), we prove that the point-to-point partition functions, viewed as random measures, converge to the critical SHF.
